model_organism.citation: Systematic Ocular Phenotyping of Knockout Mouse Lines Identifies Genes Associated With Age-Related Corneal Dystrophies (PMID: 40323269)
phenotypes: Abnormal cornea morphology in late-adult mice (49+ weeks)
Identified from IMPC data as one of 14 genes linked to late-adult corneal phenotypes (Ik, KMPC center)
Ik expressed in human cornea T/NK cells (66.67%) by single-cell transcriptomics

biological.citation: Unknown authors 2021 - Inactivating Mutations of the IK Gene Weaken Ku80/Ku70-Mediated DNA Repair and Sensitize Endometrial Cancer to Chemotherapy (PMID: 34065218)
biological.summary: Co-IP and mass spectrometry identified an IK interaction with Ku80, linking IK to Ku80/Ku70-mediated DNA repair. IK knockdown in endometrial cancer cells caused G2/M enrichment, inactivated Ku80/Ku70 DNA repair signaling, and sensitized cells to cisplatin. IK is described as a mitotic factor promoting cell cycle progression.

biological.citation: Unknown authors 2021 - Inactivating Mutations of the IK Gene Weaken Ku80/Ku70-Mediated DNA Repair and Sensitize Endometrial Cancer to Chemotherapy (PMID: 34065218)
biological.summary: Somatic IK-inactivating mutations (mostly frameshift and stop-gain) were associated with decreased IK expression. They were also linked to higher mutation burden, better chemotherapy response, and longer 10-year survival in endometrial cancer. Co-occurring IK/Ku80 mutations were associated with significantly better overall survival.
biological.significance: Reported as significantly better overall survival; no specific p-value in abstract

biological.citation: Unknown authors 1997 - Implication of a new molecule IK in CD34+ hematopoietic progenitor cell proliferation and differentiation (PMID: 9160666)
biological.summary: IK transcripts are present in CD34+ cells from human umbilical cord blood. IK expression rose during growth factor-induced proliferation and differentiation, inversely correlating with the loss of HLA-DR.

biological.citation: Unknown authors 1997 - Implication of a new molecule IK in CD34+ hematopoietic progenitor cell proliferation and differentiation (PMID: 9160666)
biological.summary: An antisense oligonucleotide against the IK mRNA initiation site decreased IK transcripts and increased HLA-DR expression. It also inhibited colony formation by multilineage, early erythroid and granulomonocytic CD34+ progenitors, reducing mean colony size by 70%. This supports a role for IK in growth factor-dependent proliferation and differentiation, via modulation of HLA-DR.

biological.citation: Unknown authors 1994 - A new cytokine (IK) down-regulating HLA class II: monoclonal antibodies, cloning and chromosome localization (PMID: 7970704)
biological.summary: IK was purified as a 19 kDa cytokine secreted by K562 leukemic cells and other cancer cells. It inhibits IFN-gamma-induced HLA class II expression, and also cycloheximide-induced HLA-DR, in Colo 205 colon carcinoma cells. Blocking mAbs antagonized this effect.

biological.citation: Unknown authors 1994 - A new cytokine (IK) down-regulating HLA class II: monoclonal antibodies, cloning and chromosome localization (PMID: 7970704)
biological.summary: The IK cDNA was cloned and sequenced. It detects a 2.1 kb mRNA in various cell types, has no homology to known cytokines, and maps to chromosome 2p15-p14. Transient transfection in COS cells produced a secreted, biologically active 19 kDa protein recognized by the blocking mAb 1C5B11.
